findings.what: No sentence says the shadow is |a| cos θ, the side next to θ as in resolving. So a·b = |a||b| cos θ appears only as a readout label until the Finish line, yet puzzle 4 (5 and 4 at 120°) needs it. Add it in one or two short sentences; the screen stays well under 90 words.

'Only matching parts are left to multiply' skips the step that makes it true. Multiply every part of one arrow by every part of the other: 3i·4i, 3i·3j, 4j·4i and 4j·3j. The two crossed pairs give 0. The brief promised the parts formula built from i·i = 1 and i·j = 0. Also 'i lies along its own line, so i·i = 1' leaves out that i is 1 long.

'Their sizes are 7 and 3, so cos θ = 20 ÷ 21' uses cos θ = a·b ÷ (|a||b|) without ever saying it. Finding the angle is the dot product's main use. Puzzle 8's hint ('Divide by the sizes multiplied') also relies on that unstated rule.

The swing (180 × go(1.8, 2.8)) eases through 90° at its fastest, about 100° a second, and never holds there. The film goes from 88.29° straight to about 115°. Then it settles at 180°, with a lying along b's line on top of its own shadow. So the brief's one thing to see, the shadow shrinking to a dot at 90°, is never held still. The finished still in the read-through shows 180°, not the 90° the text describes. Hold for about a second at 90° with 'shadow 0' and 'a·b = 0', or finish at about 120°.
a = 3i + 4j and b = 4i are never named in words, but screen 2 says 'a is still 3i + 4j'. A read-through takes the starting values from the picture alone.
Name the rule in a sentence: work is the dot product of the pull and the move, W = F·d. At present only the readout label |F||d| cos θ shows it.

findings.where: Puzzle 11 (Volts and amps), task and hint
findings.what: 'A supply gives 230 V and 23 A' reads oddly to an electrician, since the load draws the current. The hint for 5290 W could also name it as the apparent power in VA, which he knows from AC circuits.
The first frame shows an empty grid with a ghosted legend. Arrows a and b grow in only after about 0.5 s, so the captured opening state shows nothing to move.
The 3-D view is fixed and cannot be dragged to turn, unlike lesson 2's box. Depth is hard to judge from one view on a 360 px phone.
The 30rem column sits against the left edge of a wide card and leaves about 60% of it empty. Centre .pz, .lead and .caption.
'So the part b₁i gives a₁b₁' jumps from a·i = a₁ to a·(b₁i) = a₁b₁. It never says that stretching i by b₁ stretches its dot product by b₁.
